title: Power of an absolute expectation
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, let $p\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $1\le p$, and let $f:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. Writing $\mathbb E_\pi f=\sum_{x\in\Omega}\pi(x)f(x)$, one has $|\mathbb E_\pi f|^p\le \mathbb E_\pi(|f|^p)$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
